criteria.description: Optional unified workflow: As an operator, I can explicitly enable one native contribution/moderation workflow without enabling it by default or coupling it to other opt-ins.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.

criteria.description: Open submission: As an unknown contributor, I can submit signed code or communications without upstream write access, a provider account or prior project role.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.

criteria.description: Bounded intake: As a maintainer, I can inspect pending submissions through isolated validation with finite per-request and aggregate resource limits before shared visibility.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.

criteria.description: Operation authority: As a project, I apply common admission machinery with distinct permissions for creation, replies, edits, moderation, proposal admission and existing merge/execution.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.

criteria.description: Native moderation: As a moderator, I can record authorized scoped admit/reject, hide/restore and author block/unblock decisions with exact targets and visible conflicts.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.

criteria.description: Portable contribution lifecycle: As an observer, I can reconstruct pending/admitted state and moderation from immutable signed Git-backed records, preserving deduplication and interrupted recovery.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.

criteria.description: Public-contribution proof: As an adopter, I can reproduce a provider-free stranger-to-project journey and hostile-input refusals in standard/native-only builds.
criteria.notes: Owner-authorized contribution amendment; WP10-WP13 public and boundary verification required. Pending implementation and evidence.
